02/08/2023



                              NOTICE
                    Formation of Academic Council

      The Academic Council of Anandaram Dhekial Phookan College has been
reconstituted with the following functionaries. The Council will be responsible
for making policy decisions on all academic matters and overseeing academic
development within the college.

       The composition of the Council will be based on designation; whoever
holds the respective positions at any given time will be a part of this Council.

      Chairperson: Dr. Sadananda Payeng, Principal, ADP College
      Members: Dr. Mridul Kr. Hazarika, Vice-principal
                  Dr. Aparna Bairagi, Vice-principal
                  Dr. Chittaranjan Nath, Coordinator, IQAC
                  HOD of All Departments




                                                     (Dr. Sadananda Payeng)
                                                           PRINCIPAL
